title: Personnel and approvals: staff every seat of every approval version under six cross-table rules
proves: eleven target tables with 27 columns and 540 rows come from data files, demand and one policy file
R1 to R3 decide each person per position; the evidence counts the exclusions by rule and names each near miss with its reason
a license is valid on its expiry date: person 47 is the only inspector for A07-V1 and expires on its date
the search needs backtracking: its first choice for A03-V1-PLN leaves A05-V1-PLN short (R6)
versions share their approval (A01) and approvals of one company share people (A03 and A04)
an infeasible demand ends below the budget as infeasible; a too small budget ends as budget_exhausted
an independent output check per position catches a search that ignores R5
each data variant changes one fact, the search variant drops one check; Build rejects each with a row condition that names the rule
